title: WEB HACKING
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the ability of a cyber attacker to access and make changes to a computer owned by another, without authority and regardless of where the computer is geographically located."

Remote code execution (RCE) refers to the ability of a cyber attacker to access and make changes to a computer owned by another, without authority and regardless of where the computer is geographically located.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most common functionalities applications has to offer."
File upload is one of the most common functionalities applications has to offer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the process of extracting user names, machine names, network resources, shares and services from a system."
Enumeration is defined as the process of extracting user names, machine names, network resources, shares and services from a system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the backbone of data communication on the World Wide Web."
HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) is the backbone of data communication on the World Wide Web.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described elsewhere [2] and we assume that it has produced an authentication token, containing data needed for the authorization."
The authentication process is described elsewhere [2] and we assume that it has produced an authentication token, containing data needed for the authorization.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a type of a XSS where the attack is done on one channel and the output is displayed on another channel."
Blind XSS is a type of a XSS where the attack is done on one channel and the output is displayed on another channel.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a kind of web vulnerability which occurs due to the misconfiguration of session management."
Broken Authentication is a kind of web vulnerability which occurs due to the misconfiguration of session management.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of rules for internet data sharing, such as text, images, video, and other multimedia files."
Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) is a set of rules for internet data sharing, such as text, images, video, and other multimedia files.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a control scheme in which roles are granted to identities, and those roles determine what access to resources those identities should have."
Role-based access control is a control scheme in which roles are granted to identities, and those roles determine what access to resources those identities should have.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a criminal offence in academics and is highly penalized."
Plagiarism is a criminal offence in academics and is highly penalized.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a part or snippet of a code."
A payload is a part or snippet of a code.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a security vulnerability that arises from a vulnerability in web applications."
Server-side request forgery (SSRF) is a security vulnerability that arises from a vulnerability in web applications.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are one of the most important components in web security."
Passwords are one of the most important components in web security.
